name: Castilleja del Campo (Spain)
description: Red field with a green rectangle at the centre bearing a yellow castle between two white lions, surrounded by white stars and fleurs-de-lis.
history: Municipal flag of Castilleja del Campo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: large green rectangle within a red border
two lions rampant flanking the castle
six-pointed stars at the middle of the border
fleurs-de-lis in the corners of the border
